title: Lightboard — Stage Lighting Console
description: Patch a lighting rig, pull faders on 23 fixtures, record cues and crossfade a whole show in a hazy volumetric stage.
concept: A working stage lighting desk in a single page. You patch spots, pars, moving heads, cyc floods and blinders onto three trusses, then light the stage live with per-fixture intensity, gel colour, zoom, pan, edge-soften and strobe. Looks get recorded as cues with their own fade and hold times, and GO crossfades every parameter between them while a beat-synced effect engine keeps chases running underneath. The render is a volumetric haze stage: beams, floor pools, cyc wash and performer silhouettes that occlude the light.
features: 23-fixture rig editor — patch, drag onto trusses, mirror, fan and unpatch
Live console: per-fixture fader plus intensity, hue, saturation, zoom, pan, soften and strobe
Cue stack with per-cue fade/hold, GO crossfade of every parameter, and automatic show playback
Beat-synced effect engine — sine/ramp/step/bounce/sparkle across intensity, pan, hue or zoom with fan spread and tap tempo
Four full preset shows (Rock, Theatre, Nightclub, Ballad) and a grand master + haze
Export the still as PNG, the whole show as JSON, or copy a share link that carries the entire rig and cue stack

interaction.mouse: Drag a fader to set a level; drag on the stage to aim the selected fixtures; in Rig mode drag fixtures along the trusses.
interaction.click: Click a fixture or fader to select it (shift to add), tap a gel to colour it, click a cue to crossfade to it.
interaction.touch: Everything is pointer-driven — tap to select, drag faders and aim beams, tabs scroll horizontally on a phone.
interaction.keyboard: Space = GO, B = blackout, R = record cue, F = effects, 1–9 select, A all, Esc none, arrows trim intensity and pan.
